name: Google Pixel 8a
description:
Google Pixel 8a is a mid-range smartphone designed for users who value photography, software experience and smart features. It features a 6.1-inch OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, providing smooth scrolling and clear visuals. The device is powered by Google's Tensor G3 processor and includes 8GB RAM with 128GB or 256GB storage options. Its camera system consists of a 64MP main camera and a 13MP ultrawide camera, along with a 13MP front camera. The phone has a 4492mAh battery, supports wired and wireless charging, and offers 5G connectivity. It runs Android with Google's Pixel software experience and includes Titan M2 security hardware. It is suitable for users interested in photography, everyday performance, software features and a compact smartphone design.
Specifications: Display: 6.1-inch OLED
Refresh Rate: 120Hz
Processor: Google Tensor G3
RAM: 8GB
Storage: 128GB / 256GB
Rear Camera: 64MP main + 13MP ultrawide
Front Camera: 13MP
Battery: 4492mAh
Charging: 18W wired, wireless charging supported
Network: 5G
Operating System at launch: Android 14
User Interface: Pixel UI
Security: Titan M2 security chip, fingerprint unlock and face unlock
